chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) used to gather firewood, draw water, and sweep, and Fatima (peace be upon her) used to grind, knead, and bake.
ai.seo_question: What household chores did Imam Ali and Fatima perform according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi illustrates the practical embodiment of humility (tawadu') by the Ahl al-Bayt, where Imam Ali and Fatima (peace be upon them) actively shared domestic burdens despite their high spiritual station. Scholars emphasize this as a normative model (sunnah) for marital equality, refuting the notion that leadership precludes manual labor, and it is often cited in discussions on the rights of spouses within Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>
used to ignite the fire and draw the water and sweep, and Syed Fatima<sup>asws</sup> used to grind and knead and bake’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said the following: “
Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would bring firewood, water and sweep the house. Fatimah al- Zahra’, ‘Alayha al-Salam, would grind wheat, make dough and bake.”
